messages:
maria (AE): Uploaded the pen test pack and vulnerability scan evidence for Acme into the secure bucket. Link: https://s3.redwood.internal/acme/1951234567_acme-security-pack.zip :paperclip:
security-bot: Upload verified, virus scan clean. SHA256: 3b2f1a9c...
eli (Security Eng): grabbing the bundle now. quick ask — were hostnames/IPs redacted? we should not hand over customer-internal hostnames without approval.
maria (AE): Yes, redacted. I replaced hostnames with placeholder tokens and removed any customer PII. Contact at Acme is lisa@acme.com for procurement questions.
devon (Infra): I can own infra-level items (S3 ACLs, IAM policies). Initial glance: there are a couple of overly permissive policies listed in the scan. Assign to me for triage.
sarah (Solutions Eng): Can someone drop reproduction steps for the auth bypass (finding #3)? I want to validate in a controlled PoC before we propose mitigations.
eli (Security Eng): Will do. I ran a quick triage — preliminary counts: 4 HIGH, 11 MEDIUM, 9 LOW. Highs include S3 bucket ACL public, IAM wildcard role, and an auth elevation path. I started a triage sheet: https://docs.redwood.internal/triage/ACME-1951234567 (will update with owners + remediation notes).
maria (AE): Acme procurement needs a remediation timeline to approve renewal. They asked for "highs remediated or mitigated within 5 business days" and a retest plan. Can we commit to that cadence?
devon (Infra): For S3 and IAM I can do mitigations in 48 hours, then provide config diffs.
eli (Security Eng): For the auth elevation I need a code owner — could be platform team. If platform can prioritize, we can ship a fix in ~5 business days. Otherwise we'll provide a documented mitigation and compensating controls (WAF rule + tighter session TTL) as interim.
sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll schedule a short remote PoC session with Acme to validate the auth fix once we have patches. Prefer Mon/Tue next week.
allan (Legal): We can provide a remediation attestation letter after fixes and successful retest, but retests requiring professional services beyond our standard support will need an SOW. If Acme insists on vendor-led retest, quote it separately.
maria (AE): Noted. I'll confirm with Acme if they accept our internal retest or want a third-party. They also requested checksums for the artifacts we delivered. Attached in thread: SHA256s and filenames.
eli (Security Eng): Quick operational plan proposal:
- Day 0 (today): Triage complete, owners assigned (done by EOD).
- Day 1–2: Infra fixes (S3/IAM) by Devon.
- Day 1–5: Platform/code fix for auth elevation; if not complete by Day 5, apply mitigations.
- Day 3–7: Medium findings scheduled for remediation or backlog acceptance with compensating controls.
- Day 7–14: Retest window; provide attestation to Acme post-retest.
I'll update the triage sheet with per-finding ETA and slack owners.
maria (AE): Acme also asked for an exportable evidence bundle with proof of remediation (config diffs, patch PRs, retest scripts). Can we commit to producing that?
devon (Infra): Yes — I'll produce a remediation bundle: terraform diff, S3 ACL snapshots, and PR links.
sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll include PoC scripts and curl examples for the auth flow verification. Example check:
```bash
# auth bypass verification (internal)
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" https://api.redwood.internal/acme/v1/items | jq .status
```
eli (Security Eng): After fixes, security will run the retest (automated and manual steps). If any high remains, we escalate to execs and adjust timeline.
allan (Legal): Also flagging contractual notes — if remediation causes feature degradation, we need to document risk acceptance with Acme before making breaking changes.
maria (AE): Good point. I'll ask Acme if they prefer a mitigation-first approach or immediate fix. Their procurement deadline for renewal paperwork is 2026-04-05; they want remediation confirmation before that date.
eli (Security Eng): Proposed customer-facing timeline to share with Acme (subject to internal signoffs):
- Highs: mitigation/patches within 5 business days; confirmation + retest scheduled within 10 business days.
- Mediums: planned fixes or compensating controls within 10 business days.
- Lows: backlog with documented compensating controls within 30 days.
Please call out if platform or product needs to deprioritize.
sarah (Solutions Eng): I'm available for the PoC sessions. Ping me with times.
devon (Infra): I'll open remediation PRs in a dedicated branch and tag the triage sheet.
maria (AE): Thanks all — I'll get back to Acme with the proposed timeline and ask if they want a third-party retest. Will update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
eli (Security Eng): Sounds good. I'll flag any blockers if we hit resource constraints.
security-bot: Reminder — sensitive artifacts in the S3 path are access-restricted. Audit log entries will be available for the customer upon request.
maria (AE): Received. Next update expected by EOD tomorrow.
